images.caption: The image shows the main façade of the Basílica Menor de Nuestra Señora de Lourdes, located in Bogotá, Colombia. Its architectural design features axial symmetry along a central vertical axis, visible in the balanced arrangement of towers, windows, and decorative details. It also incorporates translation through the horizontal repetition of ornamental elements such as arches and columns, which reinforces the visual harmony of the Neo-Gothic structure.
